The table is headed "(Base: 2011-12=100)", which is a mislabel in the release: (a) its weights are 76.062 for Manufacturing and 11.053 for Mining & Quarrying, which the same release gives as the 2022-23 weights (the 2011-12 weights are 77.633 and 14.373); (b) it uses NIC 2025; (c) its May-25 = 116.7 and May-26 = 122.7 match the release highlight "The Quick Estimate of IIP stands at 122.7 against 116.7 in May 2025" (base 2022-23, Output PPI).
